title: IDH mutation impairs histone demethylation and results in a block to cell differentiation
central_claims: 2HG-producing IDH mutations inhibit histone demethylation and increase histone methylation.
This can block lineage-specific differentiation, including adipocyte differentiation.

source_manifest.title: Experiments from unfinished Registered Reports in the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology
source_manifest.finding: 2HG elevation replicated; histone methylation increase and correlation with 2HG were nonsignificant; differentiation endpoint could not be completed.

source_manifest.title: A heterozygous IDH1R132H/WT mutation induces genome-wide alterations in DNA methylation
source_manifest.finding: Independent heterozygous knock-in study found increased histone methylation and locus-specific H3K9 changes, supporting an epigenetic effect.
